blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — The “Integrity Chain” portal, that would allow civil society to keep track of public works projects and watch out for multibillion peso flood control anomalies similar to projects that are still being litigated today, should be operational by yearend or the first months of 2027, its developer said here on Wednesday (Sept. 23). The blockchain system is currently integrating 51 non-government organizations with the good governance surveillance network, said Brandon Angelo “Gelo” Wong, who co-founded the blockchain firm BYC (Bayanichain) Ventures.
